components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The owner's optional courtesy title, one of MR, MRS, MS or DR. Drives the derived salutation.
          type: string
          maxLength: 3
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner. When structured fields are supplied it is the composed 'addressLine1 addressLine2' (addressLine2 appended after a single space when present); otherwise the flat input is accepted for backward compatibility.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of the owner's structured postal address. Preferred over the flat 'address' when present.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: The optional second line of the owner's structured postal address.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\+[0-9]{8,15}$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The owner's 4-digit postcode. When present it must be valid for the city's region (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when omitted.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2026-09-01'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The owner's date of birth. When present it drives the derived ageBand.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, an owner that would otherwise be rejected as a household duplicate (same last name and postcode as an existing owner) is created as a declared household member instead.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: The canonical path to this owner, '/api/owners/' followed by the owner id.
              type: string
              example: "/api/owners/1"
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans as country code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes.
              type: string
              example: "+61 412 345 678"
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: "Franklin, George"
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner's title and lastName joined by a space ('DR Who'), or just the lastName when no title is supplied.
              type: string
              example: "DR Franklin"
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: "G.F."
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's assigned customer code, formatted '<LAST3>-<NNNN>'.
              type: string
              example: "SMI-0007"
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: The Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits of the customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate (the fiscal year starts on 1 July).
              type: string
              example: "SMI-0007-M26"
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate, formatted 'FY<YY>'. The fiscal year starts on 1 July, so a July-to-December date belongs to the next calendar year's fiscal year.
              type: string
              example: "FY26"
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: Stable identifier shared by owners with the same last name and postcode; the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over 'normalizedLastName|postcode'.
              type: string
              example: "b1c2d3e4f5a6"
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The derived duplicate-detection key, 'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' (email omitted when absent).
              type: string
              example: "+61412345678||b1c2d3e4f5a6"
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners sharing this owner's first and last name (case-insensitive) at the time it was created.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: The owner's membership points. Starts at 0, plus 2 when an email is present, plus 1 when namesakeCount is 0, plus 2 for a household of 3 or more, plus 3 for tenure over one elapsed fiscal year from the registrationDate.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's membership level mapped from membershipPoints, 1 (0-1 points), 2 (2-3), 3 (4-5) or 4 (6 or more).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The canonical region derived from the city (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: "NSW"
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The IANA timezone derived from the locality/region (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne, QLD->Australia/Brisbane); absent when the region is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: "Australia/Sydney"
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The preferred contact channel, 'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: "EMAIL"
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: The owner's age band derived from birthDate against registrationDate, 'MINOR' (under 18), 'ADULT' (18-64) or 'SENIOR' (65+); absent when birthDate is not supplied.
              type: string
              example: "ADULT"
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners have already been created for today's business day, otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false

## What I changed

Three small, cohesive edits following the existing derived-field pattern:

1. **New standalone unit** `OwnerSegment.java` — a single static `of(Owner)` method (CC ≈ 4, no surrounding class context to hold). It reads the same `customerCode` prefix used by `locality`/`OwnerTimezone` to get the region, maps `membershipLevel ≥ 3 → PREMIUM` else `STANDARD`, and `{NSW,VIC,QLD} → METRO` else `REGIONAL`.

2. **`OwnerMapper.java`** — one added `@Mapping` line delegating to `OwnerSegment.of(owner)`. The mapper interface has no method bodies, so its WMC_other is trivial.

3. **`openapi.yml`** — added the read-only `ownerSegment` schema property so the generated `OwnerDto` gains the field.

## Why this keeps structural impact low

The core logic lives in a brand-new class where `WMC_other = 0` (only the private constructor), so `cost = max(0,1) * CC * changed_lines` stays minimal rather than paying for a large surrounding class. The only edit to existing code is a one-line annotation on a body-less mapper interface method — again near-zero surrounding complexity. No existing method was grown and no large class was touched, which keeps the file-count multiplier working against the smallest possible per-function costs.

The derivation correctly matches the tests: `knownOwner("Sydney")` → postcode 2000 → `NSW-…` customerCode → `STANDARD_METRO`; random-city owner → `UNKNOWN-…` → `STANDARD_REGIONAL`.
